PLAN "12-Week General Strength (Post-L4-L5 Herniation, No Heavy Spinal Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength safely post-disc injury"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body & Core (No Spinal Loading)":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x20s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
